source.quote: 這邊處理完之後，我想要把角色全部都折疊回身上了，這樣子派工一點意義都沒有，你們不如自己派，你自己派出子代理來處理。

interpretation.effectiveAfter: Current S06 workspace-entry integration, complete I/R, independent Fresh Review and necessary ordinary repair reach a clear bounded result.
interpretation.futureInterface: Grape PM single Human-facing conversation handles product analysis, coordination, direct subagent implementation/review and delivery.
interpretation.retained: Human product/architecture choices, Slice authorization, acceptance and merge controls; independent technical review; single logical writer and immutable historical evidence.
interpretation.notAuthorized: No next Slice, no current S06 acceptance or merge, no scheduler or permanent service, no rewriting frozen baseline.
interpretation.handoff: Coordinator continues current technical flow without interruption; at clear review result sends PM a compact accepted-base/I/R/verdict/residual/work/services/decision handoff. PM does not become a parallel writer during this round.

workflowChanges: Record attributable future workflow control now; no broad policy rewrite or frozen edits. Operational adoption details can be handled by PM after handoff.
